scope: First stage of exploratory E3 only: C0 native SAM2 versus C1 full-frame long memory. C2/C3/C4, ablations and SAMURAI+C2 are not implemented or launched by this protocol. E4 explicitly deferred by user on 2026-10-25; no external dataset search or testing authorized now.
authorization: User requested accurate gated experiment execution on 2026-10-25. Launch only after complete matching E2 and a fresh C1 engineering smoke pass; commit before inference.

conditions.C0: Native seven-slot SAM2; all native pointer behavior
conditions.C1: Prompt plus at most 31 recent nonconditioning frames, full 4096-token frames; 131072 maximum spatial keys; same checkpoint, prompts, CPU FP32, SDPA and temporal saturation as E2. This is a higher-compute history control, not the region-sparse method.

C1_choice: 32 total frames fixed from E1's roughly 30 older-frame mean headroom plus prompt/latest, capped explicitly. Not selected using C1 Dice. This is an exploratory design choice, not a universally justified K.
engineering_smoke: Full seq2 and seq3; fresh C0 and fresh C1, repeat C1 with a fresh model. All C1 output/bank/cache fingerprints identical on replay. C1 must match C0 exactly through target age 7, when selected memories remain native. All four layers, exact stored-frame matching, unchanged pointers/parameters and <=131072 spatial keys. Repeat mismatch stops before full-cohort run.
cohort: All 23 manifest sequences; seq1/seq7 unpromptable N/A. One mask prompt at first GT-present frame; postprompt target metrics only. No held-out/generalization claim.
primary: Equal-sequence present-frame Dice; C1-C0 paired difference
secondary: first overlapping prediction after GT return (censored if none)
actual read key counts and wall time; not isolated attention cost
screening: Follow user's initial history-alone gate: report C1>C0 on equal-sequence present Dice as positive. Nonpositive result pauses this proposed branch. It does NOT refute selective regional history, since dense history can introduce distractions. No automatic C2/C3/C4 launch either way; a separate complete matched-control protocol and verified implementation are required.
statistics: Sequence as unit. Paired differences, existing 10000-replicate whole-sequence bootstrap and Wilcoxon. One exploratory primary contrast here; no confirmatory claim. Report false alarms regardless of Dice direction.
stopping: Engineering integrity failures stop the queue; unexpected efficacy results are preserved, not repaired or tuned. No clinical use. No change to the earlier held relapse-prevention protocol.
